name: General site modifiers
description: Persistent conditions and transient weather compatible with multiple site generators

fields.description: The place still partly functions, but its occupants left essential belongings behind.
Internal distances exceed expectations and demand supplies, navigation, or several stages of exploration.
Visibility is reduced, exposed ground turns muddy, tracks wash away, and leaks or rising water threaten low areas.
Heavy rain and strong wind batter the site while thunder masks distant sounds and lightning endangers exposed heights.
Visibility falls to a short distance, making landmarks, ranged observation, and long-distance orientation unreliable.
Exposed movement, projectiles, loose objects, open flames, and elevated structures become difficult to manage.
Falling snow reduces visibility and movement; fresh tracks stand out before gradually filling.
Exposed water freezes, surfaces become slick, and prolonged outdoor activity demands shelter and warmth.
Shade and drinking water become important, and prolonged exertion in exposed areas quickly becomes exhausting.
Hard impacts make exposed travel difficult and create constant noise on roofs, armor, and bare ground.
Airborne dust obscures landmarks, irritates breathing, and makes exposed routes difficult to navigate.
Fine ash coats surfaces, obscures distant landmarks, reveals recent passage, and contaminates exposed supplies.
